name: com.cwcbb.cwcinventoryengine
description: A high-performance, lightweight, 0-GC flyweight inventory, equipment, and storage engine for Unity. Features state slicing, dual-bus pipeline (events & requests), global router, defragmentation, and data-window sliding UI controllers.

samples.description: Full interactive demo scene demonstrating item spawning, equipment swapping, durability slices, save/load persistence, and UI controller bindings.
